title: Researchers develop AI-driven method to improve forecasts weeks in advance
excerpt: Haonan Chen, a CSU associate professor of electrical and computer engineering, and his team have published research that could improve the accuracy of precipitation forecasts up to two weeks in advance.
content_html:
Haonan Chen, a CSU associate professor of electrical and computer engineering, and his team have published research that could improve the accuracy of precipitation forecasts up to two weeks in advance.

The paper was recently published in npj Climate and Atmospheric Science. It introduces a novel artificial intelligence framework that generates multiple possible rainfall scenarios rather than a single prediction. The approach provides a more complete picture of future weather uncertainty and better insight into the range of conditions that may occur.

The findings build on Chen's broader efforts to advance weather prediction using AI.

"While our previous projects focused on improving AI-based short-term forecasting and advancing our understanding of atmospheric processes, this study addresses one of the most challenging forecasting variables: precipitation at medium-range time scales," Chen said.

By producing an ensemble of possible outcomes, the framework improves precipitation forecast accuracy and helps researchers better quantify uncertainty. More reliable precipitation forecasts could support decision-making in areas such as agriculture, water resource management, emergency preparedness and disaster response.

Chen and his research team hope to extend their approach to longer-range forecasts, higher-resolution predictions and additional weather variables.

Publication details

Tianyi Xiong et al, CSU-PCAST: a dual-branch transformer framework for medium-range ensemble precipitation forecasting, npj Climate and Atmospheric Science (2026). DOI: 10.1038/s41612-026-01475-9

content_html_zh:
科罗拉多州立大学电气与计算机工程系副教授陈浩南和他的团队发表了研究成果，可以提前两周提高降水预报的准确性。

该论文最近发表在 npj Climate and Atmospheric Sc​​ience 上。 它引入了一种新颖的人工智能框架，可以生成多种可能的降雨情景，而不是单一的预测。 该方法可以更全面地了解未来天气的不确定性，并更好地洞察可能发生的情况范围。

这些发现建立在陈利用人工智能推进天气预报的更广泛努力的基础上。

“虽然我们之前的项目专注于改进基于人工智能的短期预报并增进我们对大气过程的理解，但这项研究解决了最具挑战性的预报变量之一：中期时间尺度的降水，”陈说。

通过生成可能结果的集合，该框架提高了降水预报的准确性，并帮助研究人员更好地量化不确定性。 更可靠的降水预报可以支持农业、水资源管理、应急准备和灾害应对等领域的决策。

陈和他的研究团队希望将他们的方法扩展到更长期的预测、更高分辨率的预测和其他天气变量。

出版详情

Tianyi Xiong 等人，CSU-PCAST​​：用于中期集合降水预报的双分支变压器框架，npj 气候与大气科学（2026 年）。 DOI：10.1038/s41612-026-01475-9
